target: SF Rent Board Rules §4.12(a) vs. SF.gov Banking Webpage Phrasing
severity: Low — Statutory vs. Plain-English Measuring Point Nuance
finding: SF.gov's banking guide says a skipped increase is banked only if 'at least 24 full months pass without any rent increase,' while Rule 4.12(a) says 'A full 12 months must have elapsed from the date that an annual rent increase, or a portion thereof, could have been imposed.' Both describe the same first-banked-year milestone from different starting points (24 months from initial lease start = 12 months after the first skipped 12-month anniversary).
